subject: POC kickoff — stakeholder intro + load rehearsal
messages:
From: Terry O'Sullivan <terry@finpilots.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@finpilots.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff and hands-on session — coordination

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's latency profile. We're ready to kick off a short POC focused on prompt routing, prompt-review workflows, and a small load rehearsal to validate throughput.

High-level asks from our side:
- A ~90 minute kickoff with stakeholder intros and success criteria alignment
- One hands-on session (2–3 hours) for prompt review and routing configuration
- A brief load rehearsal (30–45 minutes) to validate token rate and KV cache behavior under expected concurrency

Can you share availability for next week? We're in US Pacific; ideal windows for us are 10:00–13:00 PT. Also please confirm the internal Redwood attendees and who will own the load test runbook.

Attaching a draft stakeholder list (will share the final roster after you confirm).

Best,
Terry
Terry O'Sullivan
Director of Platform Engineering
FinPilots

Hi Terry — great to hear. We're excited to run this with your team. Proposed plan and availability:

1) Stakeholder kickoff (90 min) — proposed slots next week:
   • Tue 2027-03-08 10:30–12:00 PT
   • Wed 2027-03-09 11:00–12:30 PT

2) Hands-on workshop (2.5 hours) — prompt review, routing config, basic evals:
   • Thu 2027-03-10 10:00–12:30 PT

3) Load rehearsal (30–45 min) — immediately after the workshop or next day morning.

Internal attendees I've looped in:
- Sergio (serving runtime lead) — will own the load rehearsal and metrics collection
- Vivek (solutions engineer) — will run prompt walkthroughs and routing examples
- Monica (CS lead) — will help coordinate acceptance criteria and scheduling with your team

We've attached our POC runbook (draft) that outlines the load parameters we typically test (concurrent agents, tokens/sec, KV cache warm-up) and a checklist for the kickoff. Can you confirm the final attendee list and preferred kickoff slot? If none of the proposed times work, send two windows that fit your team's calendar and we'll adjust.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Hi all — quick answers from product/infra:
- Final attendee list: Terry (platform), me (product), Priya Shah <priya.shah@finpilots.com> (SRE), and Legal (contracts@finpilots.com) for procurement touchpoints.
- Success criteria (draft):
   1) Prompt routing can be configured to route 3 priority buckets with <150ms added latency
   2) End-to-end inference at target load of 15 concurrent agents with sustained 20 tokens/sec per agent without more than 2% error rate
   3) KV cache hit behavior reduces repeated prompt cost by >= 30% for repeating patterns

Wed 03/09 11:00 PT works best for the kickoff for us. Workshop on Thu 03/10 is fine.

Thanks,
Alex
Product Manager, FinPilots
